lessons.title: AI foundations
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of ai foundations and apply it accurately to unfamiliar challenges.
lessons.core_teaching_content: AI challenge problems connect data preparation, machine-learning workflows, model evaluation, generative models, language and vision, automation and governance. Start with the task and success criterion, then consider data quality, model behaviour, evaluation and human impact. Focus specifically on ai foundations. Identify the core concepts, common misconceptions, evidence or procedure required, and the verification step that protects against error. Move from recognition to application: identify what the task tests, choose an appropriate method, execute it carefully, and check the result against the original requirements. Keep an error log that describes the underlying reasoning failure.
examples: A National AI Challenge task on ai foundations should begin by identifying the defining clue or requirement before selecting the method.
Create a new ai foundations scenario with one plausible distractor and explain why the preferred answer or solution satisfies the requirements.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National AI Challenge activity on ai foundations using a worked problem, diagram, table, passage, code trace or comparison as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on ai foundations: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar ai foundations questions or tasks without viewing solutions.
Create and complete one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and write the rule or strategy that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National AI Challenge checkpoint on ai foundations; target at least six correct and justify uncertain responses.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished National AI Challenge task demonstrating ai foundations and document the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and independent verification. Ask learners to explain the method before confirming the answer. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving ai foundations.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
